strings.name: Sadio Mané
strings.summary: Mané developed in Senegal before bringing pace, pressing and off-ball movement to Liverpool's European and English title teams. In 2022 he helped Senegal win the 2021-edition Africa Cup of Nations and twice became African footballer of the year. After Bayern he joined Al-Nassr in 2023. Named best player of the 2025-edition AFCON in 2026, he saw that final's on-field victory overturned; Senegal's appeal remained unresolved at the cutoff.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 16, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped lead Senegal to its first AFCON title and achieved representative success in international club football.

strings.timeline.t1.title: AFCON result overturned
